## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the dimension an atomic constraint tests (the [odrl:leftOperand](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/leftOperand)) — dateTime, spatial, count, purpose, recipient, … — by referencing a [`gmeow:LeftOperand`](../classes/gmeow-LeftOperand.md) value.

### Avoid when

- Avoid giving one atomic constraint several operands (it is functional) and avoid a free-text dimension; reference a [`gmeow:LeftOperand`](../classes/gmeow-LeftOperand.md) value.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:leftOperand`](gmeow-leftOperand.md) once per [`AtomicConstraint`](../classes/gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:LeftOperand`](../classes/gmeow-LeftOperand.md) value, paired with [`gmeow:constraintOperator`](gmeow-constraintOperator.md) and [`gmeow:rightOperand`](gmeow-rightOperand.md).

### Examples

- ex:until2030 [`gmeow:leftOperand`](gmeow-leftOperand.md) [`gmeow:leftOpDateTime`](../individuals/gmeow-leftOpDateTime.md).
